verdict.rationale: Braintrust has one documented recurring job of its own: Patterns runs its Loop agent over the trace backlog "on a schedule" to find recurring problems. There is no evidence that users can define, configure, or schedule their own recurring jobs or workflows. CI/CD eval runs depend on an external pipeline, and online scoring fires as logs arrive rather than on a schedule, so neither counts. missing for 10: user-definable scheduled jobs (e.g. recurring evals or exports), cron/interval configuration, schedule management via API/CLI/MCP, documentation of Patterns' schedule controls, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Patterns puts Loop to work on your trace backlog on a schedule.
